# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.x     | :white_check_mark: Yes |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

**Email**: security@example.com

If you discover a security issue in this SDK, please include:

- Reproduction steps
- Affected version
- Potential impact
- Suggested fix, if possible

We will acknowledge receipt as soon as possible and work with you to resolve the issue before public disclosure.
